items.question: Why is the locus within the body designated as a cremation ground?
premises: A cremation ground is associated with consuming and dissolution.
Within the body there is a locus that devours time.
Devouring time constitutes a dissolving function.
items.inference: Therefore the locus within the body is called a cremation ground because it devours time.
uncertainties: The precise referent of the inner locus is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Within the body, that which devours time is therefore remembered as the cremation ground.
